recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-6238 unless the work group separately wants to clean up removed-resource source files outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-6238 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ImagingStudy clarification asking whether WADO-RS was equivalent to the then-current phrases "DICOM contexts" and "DICOM constructs", or whether the specification should link to the relevant DICOM material. The resolution was to update the Scope definition to clarify the relationship.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn/git-svn revision 5644, now git commit 6823a9388a1370a5f0e577294b1fc708b78f0164, which replaced the ambiguous ImagingStudy scope paragraph about "DICOM contexts" and "equivalent DICOM constructs" with DICOM attribute wording and a DICOM PS3.3 link.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current ImagingStudy scope no longer contains the ambiguous phrases and now explains that ImagingStudy describes a single DICOM imaging study, maps elements to DICOM attributes, links DICOM Parts 3, 4, and 6, and distinguishes DICOMweb search/retrieve services from the FHIR resource. A remaining "DICOM constructs" phrase is only in imagingmanifest, which source/fhir.ini lists under removed-resources rather than as the active ImagingStudy artifact. Later ImagingStudy work such as FHIR-47626 and FHIR-47660 refined the same area without reintroducing the ambiguity.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ImagingStudy source already satisfies the requested clarification, and editing removed ImagingManifest text or adding redundant ImagingStudy prose would not improve the current built specification.

related_jiras.note: R6 ImagingStudy scope/usage wording was refined without reintroducing the ambiguous DSTU1 DICOM context/construct language.
R6 ImagingStudy endpoint descriptions were clarified around DICOM WADO-RS/QIDO/WADO-URI services and are consistent with the no-change decision.
